jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
**SUMMARY:** The Clinical Implementation Specialist supports the successful launch, implementation, and ongoing adoption of clinical laboratory testing programs across healthcare practices throughout the United States. This position is ideal for an **RN or LPN** who enjoys educating clinical teams, building relationships with healthcare providers, solving workflow challenges, and traveling to customer locations.


The position serves as a clinical resource throughout the implementation process, working closely with Sales, Laboratory Operations, Client Services, Billing/Reimbursement, and other internal teams to coordinate account launches, provide training, resolve implementation challenges, and support successful transition to routine operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the implementation and onboarding of new physician practices and healthcare organizations, coordinating implementation plans with Sales and Operations.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual implementation meetings and training for providers, nurses, medical assistants, practice managers, and other clinical staff.
* Educate clinical teams on laboratory testing programs, patient identification, specimen collection and requirements, test ordering, requisitions, shipping, documentation, result access, and applicable medical\-necessity requirements.
* Assist practices with integrating laboratory testing into existing clinical workflows and provide hands\-on support during initial patient testing when appropriate.
* Ensure practices have the necessary supplies, educational materials, training resources, and implementation support for a successful launch.
* Follow up with newly implemented accounts to assess adoption, identify barriers, and address workflow, specimen, ordering, training, or other implementation issues.
* Provide refresher training and ongoing support as needed and assist with transitioning accounts to routine operational support.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and clinical staff while serving as a trusted clinical resource.
* Serve as a liaison between customers and internal Sales, Laboratory Operations, Client Services, Billing/Reimbursement, and technical teams.
* Communicate implementation status, risks, challenges, and follow\-up needs to appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Participate in pre\-implementation discussions, sales meetings, conferences, customer events, clinical education programs, and national product or program launches as needed.
* Assist with the development and improvement of training materials, implementation guides, checklists, and other clinical resources.
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and communicate customer and field feedback to internal teams.


Requirements:
**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Active Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license.
* Minimum of 2 yrs of clinical healthcare experience in a physician office, outpatient clinic, hospital, specialty practice, or similar healthcare environment.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and patient care processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to effectively educate and communicate with physicians, nurses, medical assistants, practice managers, and administrative staff.
* Strong organization and project\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and adapt to changing circumstances in the field.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, virtual meeting platforms, and common business technology.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively throughout the United States.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND CONDITIONS:**


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.


The position involves frequent travel and work in clinic, group medical practice, and other healthcare environments, including potential exposure to communicable diseases or body fluids. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear and frequently required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools, supplies, and controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds, including training materials, supplies, or equipment. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The position may require extended periods of travel and time spent in healthcare facilities and customer locations.

**HOURS AND TRAVEL:**

* Full\-time, primarily field\-based position.
* Approximately **60–75%** nationwide travel, including frequent overnight travel.
* Independent travel throughout the United States by air and ground transportation.
* When not traveling, the position will support customers and internal teams remotely from the Charlotte, North Carolina area.

jobs.title: Sr. Sales Enablement Specialist (Training Specialist)
jobs.description:
ABM Industries is seeking a Sr. Sales Enablement Specialist (Training Specialist) to join our Sales Enablement Team. This role is responsible for designing, delivering, and measuring sales training programs that build the skills, knowledge, and behaviors our sales organization needs to succeed. The ideal candidate blends instructional design expertise, strategic thinking, and sales acumen, and is comfortable both building courses from the ground up and standing in front of a room facilitating live training. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Sales Enablement.

**Benefit Information:**


ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM Employee Benefits \| Staff \& Management

 **Pay:** $95,000 – $135,000


The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Instructional Design \& Course Development**
----------------------------------------------

* Design and develop training courses using the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation)
* Create skills matrices and rubrics to define and assess learner competency and performance
* Develop engaging multimedia content using Vyond or similar animated video/e\-learning authoring tools
* Design scalable training content and programs that can be efficiently adapted and reused across teams, regions, and evolving sales priorities
* Apply strategic thinking to align training content and priorities with broader sales and business objectives
* Partner closely with Sales Leaders and Subject Matter Experts, including those at the VP and Director level, to design and develop new learning content that reflects current sales priorities and field realities
* Leverage AI tools, including custom GPTs, to streamline content development, course creation, and other Sales Enablement workflows

**Classroom \& Facilitation**
-----------------------------

* Plan and deliver classroom\-based training sessions, including interactive activities, role\-plays, and hands\-on exercises
* Develop detailed lesson plans and facilitator guides to support consistent, high\-quality delivery
* Facilitate onboarding and ongoing training for new and existing sales team members
* Provide coaching and constructive feedback to sales team members on pitches and presentations to strengthen delivery and messaging

**Sales Methodology \& Tools Training**
---------------------------------------

* Train sales staff on Client\-Based Selling — ABM's name for its sales methodology, closely aligned with the Challenger Sales Methodology — or a comparable consultative/prescriptive sales methodology (e.g., Challenger Sales Methodology, Prescriptive Sales Methodology, Solution Selling, GAP Selling)
* Provide training and support on core sales tools, including ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Salesforce

**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------

* Define and track success metrics for training programs (e.g., knowledge retention, skill application, performance impact)
* Analyze training outcomes and adjust programs based on data and feedback
* Report on training effectiveness to Sales Enablement and sales leadership

**Education**
=============

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Organizational Development, or a related field
* Coursework or certification in Sales or Sales Methodology (e.g., Challenger Sales Methodology, Prescriptive Sales Methodology, Solution Selling, GAP Selling, or a similar recognized consultative selling certification) preferred, supporting the Client\-Based Selling training requirement
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree / certifications

**Qualifications**
==================

* 8\+ years of experience in sales training, sales enablement, instructional design, or a related field in a B2B corporate environment
* Demonstrated experience applying the ADDIE model or similar instructional design framework
* Experience creating skills assessments and evaluation rubrics
* Proficiency with Vyond or a comparable e\-learning/animation authoring tool
* Strong strategic thinking skills, with the ability to connect training initiatives to broader sales and business objectives
* Ability to design scalable content and programs that can flex across audiences, teams, and growth stages
* Experience using AI tools to build custom GPTs or similar AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency and workflow
* Prior experience administering an LMS required (LMS administration is not an ongoing responsibility of this role, but familiarity with LMS workflows is expected)
* Proven experience facilitating classroom or live training sessions
* Experience coaching sales professionals on pitch delivery and presentation skills, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback
* Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships with senior stakeholders, including VP\- and Director\-level Sales Leaders and SMEs
* Familiarity with Client\-Based Selling (ABM's methodology, aligned with the Challenger Sales Methodology) or a similar consultative/prescriptive sales methodology, such as the Challenger Sales Methodology, Prescriptive Sales Methodology, Solution Selling, or GAP Selling
* Working knowledge of ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Salesforce
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills
* Ability to travel up to 30%
* Must be based in Atlanta, GA

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in a Sales Enablement or Sales Training role
* Background in B2B sales or sales leadership
* Certification in Instructional Design or Adult Learning (e.g., ATD Master Trainer, CPLP) a plus, given the ADDIE\-based course development responsibilities
* Experience building measurement frameworks tied to business outcomes (e.g., revenue impact, pipeline conversion)


**About Us**
  

  

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of facility services and solutions. A driving force for a cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable world, ABM provides essential services and forward\-looking performance solutions that improve the spaces and places that matter most. From curbside to rooftop, ABM’s comprehensive services include janitorial, engineering, parking, electrical and lighting, energy and electric vehicle charging infrastructure, HVAC and mechanical, landscape and turf, and mission critical solutions. ABM serves a wide range of industries – from commercial office buildings to universities, airports, hospitals, data centers, manufacturing plants and distribution centers, entertainment venues and more. Founded in 1909, ABM serves over 20,000 clients, with annualized revenue approaching $8 billion and more than 100,000 team members in 350\+ offices throughout the United States, United Kingdom, Republic of Ireland, and other international locations. For more information, visit http://www.abm.com.
  

  

ABM is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer qualified applicants without regard race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran or any other protected factor under federal, state, or local law. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888\-328\-8606\. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case\-by\-case basis.
  

  

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program. E\-Verify is an internet\-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.
  

  

ABM is a military\-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world\-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post\-military career opportunities across ABM.
  

ABM directs all applicants to apply at http://www.abm.com/ ABM does not accept unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**WHO WE ARE**

Are you looking for an inclusive environment, a remote\-first opportunity, and an employee experience that's engaging, exciting, and meaningful? At Momentive Software, we're the leading software platform for nonprofits and associations. For more than 40 years, we've helped over 37,000 mission\-driven organizations streamline operations, deepen member engagement, and drive meaningful impact all through one connected technology ecosystem.  



Our Company portfolio spans the full range of nonprofit and association needs:


* Association Management Software (MC Trade, NimbleAMS, YourMembership, NetForum, WildApricot, MC Trade, MC Pro, and more)
* Event Management Software (A2Z Events)
* Learning Management Software (Path LMS)
* Fundraising \& Donor Management Software (GiveSmart)
* Accounting Software (MIP)
* Certification Management, Career Centers, Volunteer Management, and Community

MomentiveIQ: our AI layer that automates workflows, personalizes engagement, and delivers predictive insights across the entire ecosystem (Coming soon to MC Trade!)  

* 

  

**WHO WE NEED**

We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to join our implementation team with a core platform focus on SMB association management software (AMS). In this role, you'll lead onboarding projects for new accounts and deliver professional services training and consulting for existing Clients. You'll guide Clients through discovery, recommend best\-practice solutions, configuration of platform(s), and ensure successful adoption through go\-live and beyond. As a trusted advisor, you'll help organizations achieve their goals while delivering an exceptional Client experience.
  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You're an experienced implementation professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges and helping Clients succeed. You quickly learn new technologies, communicate technical concepts to audiences of all experience levels, and approach every Client engagement with a consultative mindset. You're collaborative, proactive, and energized by improving processes, sharing knowledge, and delivering exceptional Client experiences.  



  

**HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT**

**Lead Client Implementations**

* Own and deliver end\-to\-end Client onboarding projects, consistently meeting or exceeding individual and team performance metrics.
* Lead implementation projects by proactively managing scope, timelines, milestones, risks, and Client expectations from kickoff through go\-live.
* Navigate changing priorities and evolving Client requirements while maintaining project momentum and delivering successful outcomes.

**Consult, Configure, and Deliver Solutions**

* Identify Client requirements and recommend best\-practice software configurations that align with each association's business goals and operational needs.
* Facilitate data migration, software configuration, testing, and validation to ensure a seamless implementation experience.
* Deliver professional services consulting engagements, including workflow assessments, training sessions, and solution recommendations that maximize Client success.

**Enable Client Success**

* Train and empower Clients to confidently adopt platform(s) through engaging instruction, workflow recommendations, and industry best practices.
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, throughout the implementation lifecycle.

**Strengthen the Team**

* Collaborate cross\-functionally to continuously improve onboarding processes, implementation standards, and the overall Client experience.

Serve as a subject matter expert by sharing best practices, contributing to documentation, mentoring teammates, and supporting continuous process improvement.  

* 

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Success in this role is measured by:


* Delivering high\-quality implementations that meet Client objectives.
* Consistently achieving Client satisfaction and positive implementation outcomes.
* Delivering projects on time while effectively managing scope and expectations.

Contributing to team knowledge, process improvements, and operational excellence.  

* 

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
* 2\+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, Client onboarding, or professional services.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent software implementation projects.
* Experience with Association Management Software (AMS) or similar membership/nonprofit platforms is preferred.

**Technical \& Project Management Skills**

* Strong Microsoft Excel and data management skills.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to quickly learn new software applications and technologies.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.

**Professional Skills**

* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Client\-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional Client experiences.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Comfortable holding Clients and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon timelines and project expectations.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and maintain momentum across complex Client projects.
* A proactive, continuous\-improvement mindset with a desire to contribute ideas that strengthen team performance and Client outcomes.

**About Us**
============

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose\-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission\-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud\-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .  

  



**Why Work Here?**
==================

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem\-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

\*\*Hybrid/Remote Position; must be in one of the following markets: West Palm Beach, Broward County, Boca Raton or Boynton Beach\*\*

**ABOUT PEOPLEONE HEALTH:**


PeopleOne Health is one of the fastest\-growing providers of value\-based primary care and has earned the best\-in\-class member satisfaction scores. We deliver exceptional healthcare that reduces costs and significantly improves health outcomes by focusing on preventive care, behavior change, and keeping people healthier. The key to our successful culture is living our motto: care for yourself; care for each other; care for our members.

**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Clinical Training Specialist is responsible for the development, coordination, and delivery of clinical training programs across new and existing health center locations. This position plays a critical role in ensuring clinical team members—including Medical Assistants, Providers, and other care team members—are trained in accordance with organizational standards, protocols, and workflows. The Specialist supports new hire onboarding, conducts competency assessments, and provides ongoing education and remediation to promote clinical quality, patient safety, and team performance.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


This position provides supervision to others: No

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Deliver structured orientation programs for Medical Assistants, clinical staff, and Providers.
* Conduct on\-site and virtual training for new clinic openings, including workflow simulation and go\-live support.
* Develop and update training materials, job aids, checklists, and policy\-based education tools.
* Collaborate with Area Managers, Clinical Leaders, and Operations to assess training needs.
* Facilitate mock clinics, hands\-on skills training, and real\-time coaching during and after new health center go\-live.
* Conduct chart audits and clinical quality checks to identify trends and provide targeted remediation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for EMR workflows, clinical processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Track training participation and competency validation in collaboration with the Training Coordinator.
* Stay current with clinical practice guidelines, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements.

**Other Duties:**

* Participate in the creation and execution of clinical onboarding plans for new hires.
* Support training initiatives related to quality improvement, patient experience, and EMR changes.
* Provide peer coaching, mentorship, and support to new or developing clinical team members.
* Assist in the development and implementation of training strategies for enterprise initiatives.
* Travel to health center locations as needed (estimated 50% \- 75%). May require an irregular schedule that changes weekly and monthly based on travel needs. May be expected to work some weekends and an occasional holiday.


Requirements:
**SKILLS \& ABILITIES:**

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for diverse adult learning styles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to assess training needs, identify skill gaps, and provide constructive feedback.
* Skilled in EMR workflows, clinical documentation, and chart auditing.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (docs, sheets, slides) and familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various locations.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive working relationships with clinical and operational teams.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills.

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS \& CLEARANCES:**

* Required: Associate’s Degree in Nursing or allied health profession (e.g., MA, RT, LPN, RN).
* Current BLS/AED Certification
* Child Clearance \- Act 33
* Criminal Clearance \- Act 38
* FBI Clearance \- Act 73

**EXPERIENCE:**

* Required: Minimum 3 years of experience in a clinical role in primary care, urgent care, or similar outpatient setting.
* Required: Minimum 1 – 3 years experience in formal training delivery.
* Preferred: Experience in training program development or clinical education.
* Preferred: Familiarity with electronic health records (e.g., eClinicalWorks).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

*(The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the position’s essential functions.)*

* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely throughout clinical environments.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds (training equipment, materials).
* Ability to travel between clinic sites, including overnight stays.
* Prolonged periods working on a computer.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

jobs.title: Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist Position Overview

Charm Experts is seeking a senior, client\-facing **Charm Health Account Implementation Optimization Specialist** to lead the setup, implementation, training, and ongoing optimization of CharmHealth EHR accounts for medical practices.

This position requires more than general familiarity with the platform. The successful candidate will take ownership of implementations following the initial sale, assess each practice’s clinical and administrative needs, translate those requirements into an effective CharmHealth configuration, and guide the client from discovery through go\-live and post\-launch stabilization.

Our clients range from solo providers launching new practices to established, multi\-provider organizations migrating from other EHR platforms or seeking to improve their existing CharmHealth environment.

Position Type

This position will initially be structured as a part\-time independent contractor engagement, with the potential to transition into full\-time employment based on performance, client demand, and company growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead client discovery, kickoff, implementation, and workflow\-planning meetings.
* Evaluate each practice’s clinical, administrative, scheduling, billing, and patient\-engagement requirements.
* Develop tailored implementation plans, timelines, and task lists.
* Configure new and existing CharmHealth accounts, including:
* Practice, facility, provider, and staff settings
* Roles, permissions, and user access
* Appointment types, scheduling rules, and provider calendars
* Clinical workflows and encounter settings
* Custom charting and specialty\-specific clinical templates
* Intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and patient communications
* Patient portal registration and workflows
* Telehealth services
* E\-prescribing and EPCS coordination
* Laboratory and imaging integrations
* Diagnosis, procedure, medication, and laboratory preference lists
* Billing, coding, payment, and clearinghouse workflows
* Support patient\-data migration and validate the accuracy and completeness of imported records.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and communicate with CharmHealth, clearinghouses, laboratories, pharmacies, and other vendors as needed.
* Train providers, practice administrators, clinical staff, and front\-office personnel.
* Create written implementation documentation, workflow guides, and training materials.
* Manage multiple client projects, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Provide go\-live support, troubleshooting, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and recommend improvements to workflows, templates, reporting, and system utilization.
* Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clients throughout each engagement.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, API integrations, analytics, and continued account optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Five or more years of EHR implementation, configuration, onboarding, or optimization experience.
* Substantial direct, hands\-on experience with the CharmHealth EHR and practice\-management platform.
* Demonstrated ability to configure CharmHealth accounts for real\-world medical\-practice operations.
* Experience translating clinical and administrative workflows into efficient system configurations.
* Strong understanding of medical\-practice operations, including scheduling, documentation, patient intake, prescribing, laboratory workflows, billing, and revenue\-cycle processes.
* Experience developing clinical templates, intake forms, questionnaires, consent forms, and standardized workflows.
* Experience training clinical and nonclinical users with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Strong project\-management, organizational, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent client\-facing communication and consultative skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and take ownership of projects from discovery through stabilization.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the proper handling of protected health information.

Strongly Preferred

* Approximately five years of direct CharmHealth implementation and optimization experience.
* Experience implementing CharmHealth across multiple specialties or practice types.
* Experience working with solo providers, startup practices, telehealth organizations, and multi\-provider medical groups.
* Experience with patient\-data migration and EHR transition projects.
* Knowledge of CharmHealth billing, eClaims, clearinghouse, and revenue\-cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with CharmHealth APIs and third\-party integrations.
* Experience with workflow\-automation and analytics platforms such as Zoho, n8n, or comparable systems.
* Experience developing reusable implementation standards, checklists, training programs, and account\-optimization plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful specialist will be able to take a new client from an initial requirements discussion to a properly configured, documented, and stable CharmHealth environment. Providers and staff should be prepared to use the system confidently at go\-live, with efficient workflows supporting patient care, practice operations, billing, compliance, and future growth.

To Apply

Please provide:

* A résumé or summary of your relevant professional experience
* A two\- to three\-minute video introducing yourself and describing your experience working with CharmHealth
* The number of years you have worked directly with CharmHealth
* Examples of CharmHealth implementations, configurations, or optimization projects you have completed
* The types and sizes of medical practices you have supported
* Examples of clinical templates, forms, workflows, integrations, or training programs you have developed
* Your availability and preferred engagement structure
* Your hourly rate or compensation requirements

Pay: $67,964\.52 \- $81,849\.74 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Senior Implementation Project Specialist**About your role:**


As a Senior Implementation Project Specialist, you will lead implementation activities for new and existing clients, helping ensure solutions are delivered on time and aligned to client requirements. You will work closely with clients and cross\-functional internal teams to coordinate project execution, maintain implementation standards, and support scalable, well\-documented delivery processes that contribute to successful client outcomes.

**What you'll do:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Lead projects from initial planning through final implementation, coordinating activities with internal resources and external stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain project plans, task lists, timelines, and status updates to support delivery against client requirements.
* Configure implementation parameters and enter key setup information into proprietary systems and databases.
* Manage multiple implementation activities across internal teams to support timely completion and operational readiness.
* Maintain implementation documentation, procedures, and project audit records related to new products, features, and client\-specific requirements.
* Support issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and after\-hours implementation activities when needed.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

* 5\+ years of experience in project coordination, implementation, or project management supporting client delivery, installation, or solution rollout activities.
* 4\+ years of experience managing multiple concurrent projects, timelines, and stakeholder communications in a client\-facing environment.
* Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to create project documentation, status reporting, and implementation materials.
* Experience documenting implementation procedures, tracking deliverables, and supporting issue resolution across cross\-functional teams.
* High school diploma, General Educational Development (GED), associate degree, or higher, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience supporting electronic funds transfer (EFT), ATM, or financial services implementations.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience working with proprietary configuration tools, client setup workflows, or operational readiness processes.

**How you'll work:**

* This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F\-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H\-1B, H\-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

* Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well\-being.
* Paid holidays and generous time away policies.
* No\-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.

* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one.
* Retirement planning including 401k match and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
* Tuition assistance and reimbursement program.
* Paid parental and military leave.
